rationale: The assistant correctly declined buying advice (though it drifted slightly by naming brands like Miele, unrealistic under £400) and then correctly pivoted to the in-scope fault, identifying the hum plus retained water as a probable blocked pump filter with safe unplug-first, towels-down instructions. Fidelity and language handling were good, and the Hotpoint filter location was plausible. Calibration weakened at the end: 'if it turns out clear, I would recommend just going ahead with your replacement purchase' skips cheaper checks (drain hose kink, sink trap, pump impeller obstruction behind the housing) and overstates that a pump replacement would exceed the machine's value, when a Hotpoint drain pump is a cheap part. Overall a useful, safe but unfinished conversation.
